info.name: Caiyun Weather Air Quality Alerts API
Caiyun Weather Get Severe Weather Alerts

params.name: token
params.description: Caiyun Weather API token issued by the Open Platform (platform.caiyunapp.com). Embedded in the path rather than a header.

params.name: lnglat
params.description: Longitude,latitude tuple as `lng,lat` (note the order — longitude first). Use WGS84 decimal degrees.

items.docs: Returns the active severe-weather alerts published by the China Meteorological Administration for the requested location, including title, code, status, description, region (province/city/county), adcode, publication timestamp, and originating source.
